unit: 2.13 U9 - release dry run and local install proof

dry_run.checkout_resolution_proof: the dispatched tag does not exist; build legs compiled this branch's commit because the checkout ref resolves to github.sha under dry_run, proven by the Windows CLI binaries containing the working adapter (live snapshot with 17 refs through the installed x64 binary) rather than the main-line stub
dry_run.first_attempt_failure_record: run 32897071020 failed: the Windows archive listing assertion assigned a one-element pipeline to a scalar (its .Count was the character length), and ffi-release-gates still checked out the nonexistent tag; both fixed in b570cd2 before the recorded run

local_install_proof_x64.tampered_archive: second-entry copy rejected with 'Release archive has unexpected entries'
local_install_proof_x64.installArchive: placed agent-desktop-win32-x64.exe (2429440 bytes) into scratch binDir; no .extract-* staging left behind
local_install_proof_x64.npm_pack: npm/agent-desktop-0.8.3.tgz packed from the working tree
local_install_proof_x64.global_install: installed into a scratch prefix via npm install -g <tarball>; postinstall ran against AGENT_DESKTOP_BINARY_PATH pointing at the installArchive output of the downloaded release archive
local_install_proof_x64.shim_interaction: set-value on the notepad textfield ref => ok=true delivery=delivered_verified; get --property value read back 'agent-desktop npm channel proof'

not_proven_before_publication.curl_fetch_of_release_url: postinstall's download leg is platform-agnostic code unchanged by this sub-phase and exercised on every macOS install; no Windows asset is published yet, so the curl fetch of a GitHub Release URL is not exercised here
not_proven_before_publication.release_notes_text: release-please composes notes from Conventional Commit subjects at publication time; this PR's feat: subjects name Windows explicitly, which is the mechanism - there is no separate notes file to edit
